definitions.gloss: bottom futon; mattress futon; futon mattress
definitions.explanation: The futon placed on the floor to sleep on, as opposed to the top futon (comforter) placed over the body. Part of the traditional Japanese bedding set.

examples.japanese: {敷布団|しきぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}いて→敷く：00366_shiku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: I lay out the bottom futon before going to sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{敷布団|しきぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}した→干す：00115_hosu⟧。
examples.english: The weather was nice, so I aired out the futon mattress.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{敷布団|しきぶとん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厚|あつ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{快適|かいてき}→快適：00140_kaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れる→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: This futon mattress is thick enough to sleep comfortably on tatami.

notes:
USAGE:
Pairs with ⟦{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}→掛け布団：07014_kakebuton⟧ (top futon/comforter). Together they form a complete Japanese bedding set. Stored in a {押|お}し{入|い}れ (closet) during the day.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敷布団|しきぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧ (to lay out the futon mattress)
- {敷布団|しきぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧ (to air out the futon mattress)
- {敷布団|しきぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{畳|たた}む→畳む：02073_tatamu⟧ (to fold up the futon mattress)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}→掛け布団：07014_kakebuton⟧: top futon, comforter — the blanket-like futon placed on top
